correction: The prior one-brain-vs-many-brains-inside-ADV_Elite framing was wrong. JANUS itself is the distributed organism; ADV_Elite is one autonomous cognitive node/organ within it.

source_basis.README.md: Defines a heterogeneous ESP32/M5Stack swarm with explicit protocol boundaries.
source_basis.docs/architecture.md: Defines multiple firmware roles sharing selected state through ESP-NOW and supported Wi-Fi/Stratum paths.
source_basis.docs/current-swarm-state.md: Lists ADV Elite/Beacon as one distinct node among Core2, Buzz, Blind Eye, Zim, PEA4 and other roles.

organism_model.ADV_Elite: portable predictive Beacon/Tachyon/M2R organ and autonomous local cognition node
organism_model.other_nodes: autonomous specialist peers with their own state, models and telemetry

swarm_level_rules: nodes exchange observations, predictions and confidence selectively
source identity and provenance are preserved
peer disagreement is retained as information rather than averaged away blindly
stale or missing nodes remain explicit

inherited_protocol_invariants: ESP-NOW packet structures are ABI/versioned boundaries
real sensor truth remains distinguishable from predictions, simulation and UI
adaptive cognition does not reinterpret protocol truth
implication_for_ADV_Elite: ADV_Elite becomes a strong portable predictive/time-navigation organ, but not a monarch. It learns locally, exchanges compact state with peers, predicts world+swarm+self and contributes predictions back to the collective JANUS organism.
failure_recorded: Previous Q05 A/B framing incorrectly treated ADV_Elite as if it might contain the whole JANUS brain.
